Pi Changelog2026-10-15 快照

pi 更新履历
0.10.0 → 1.3.0

十一个月、289 个版本、3131 条变更。从 2025-11-25 的「TUI + 七个工具」起步，到 2026-10 的 codemode、MCP、虚拟模型与缓存优化。本页把它切成六段来讲，再把 121 条破坏性变更单列成表，最后附一份全量可检索的版本归档。

数据源：本机 node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/CHANGELOG.md（1.3.0，629 KB）
抓取方式：解析 markdown 后整页内联生成，条目原文为英文，分期说明与本机影响为中文整理。

01总览 02发布节奏 03六段分期 04破坏性变更 05与本机 06全量归档

总览

Overview

289 个版本按类别拆开的条目数分布，以及最直观的几个数：发版最密集的是 2025 年 12 月（一个版本号体系里能连发 75 版），最近一个月回落到每周 1–2 版。

版本总数 289 0.10.0 → 1.3.0
时间跨度 11 个月 2025-11 → 2026-10
条目总数 3131 按分类拆分
破坏性变更 121 分布于 50 个版本
最忙一个月 75 2025-12 发了 75 个版本
最近一版 1.3.0 2026-10-15

六段分期

Six Eras

按版本号与日期切成六段，每段给一句主线、几条关键事实和代表版本。想快速了解「pi 是怎么长成现在这样的」，看这一节就够；具体某条改动去最后一节搜。

01

从零到能用：TUI 骨架与工具集

0.10.0 – 0.30.2 · 2025-11-25 → 2025-12-26 · 88 个版本 · 259 条

2025-11-25 首发，随后一个月内几乎天天发版。交互式 TUI、七个内置工具、会话续接这些基本盘都在这一段落定；凭据、设置、会话 ID 也随之定型。

  • 首发即含 read/write/edit/bash/glob/grep/think 七个工具、/export HTML 导出、/model 运行时切模型，接 Anthropic / OpenAI / Google 三家。
  • hook 与 custom tool 体系在 12 月内长出雏形，随后被 0.35.0 合并为 extensions（见下一段）。
  • 0.28.0 把 API key 从 settings.json 搬进 auth.json；0.29.0 把 /clear 改名 /new；0.29.1 统一出 /settings 菜单并支持 SYSTEM.md 替换系统提示。
  • 0.31.0 会话条目改用 8 位短 ID，同时修掉 edit 在 Windows 上的 CRLF 匹配失败与 UTF-8 BOM 报错 —— 本机使用史里第一次出现 Windows 专属修复。
0.10.0 Initial public release 初版：TUI + 七个工具 + HTML 导出。
0.28.0 凭据搬家 apiKeys 从 settings.json 移除，改存 ~/.pi/agent/auth.json（破坏性）。
0.29.1 统一 /settings 思考级别、主题、队列模式收进一个菜单；自动加载 SYSTEM.md。
0.31.0 Windows 修修补补 CRLF 行尾与 BOM 导致 edit 失败的经典坑被修。
02

扩展体系成形：hooks → extensions

0.31.0 – 0.50.9 · 2026-01-02 → 2026-02-01 · 60 个版本 · 652 条

一月份的工作几乎都在给「第三方能插手 pi 的每个角落」铺路：消息队列拆成 steer / followUp、hooks 与 custom tools 合并成 extensions、浮层 UI 组件、RPC 协议。同时也是 provider 大扩张的开始。

  • 0.32.0 把 queueMessage() 拆成 steer / followUp 两套语义（6 条破坏性变更），消息插入时机从此可分辨。
  • 0.35.0 是扩展体系的分水岭：hooks + customTools 合并为单一 extensions，目录 hooks/、tools/ → extensions/，commands/ → prompts/，flag --hook/--tool → --extension。
  • 0.39.0 起 ctx.ui.custom({ overlay: true }) 能画浮动模态层，扩展的 UI 能力从纯文本行升级到组件树。
  • provider 侧：Hugging Face（0.50.2）、Kimi For Coding（0.50.3）、Vercel AI Gateway、OpenAI Codex 官方支持（0.47.0）密集接入；0.50.4 补上 SSH / mosh 下的 OSC 52 剪贴板。
0.32.0 steer / followUp 队列 API 一分为二，queueMode 改名 steeringMode（破坏性）。
0.35.0 extensions 单轨 hooks 与 custom tools 合流；目录与 CLI flag 全部改名（破坏性）。
0.39.0 overlay 组件 ctx.ui.custom({ overlay: true }) 支持浮动模态 UI。
0.50.4 OSC 52 /copy 在远程连接下也能写进本地剪贴板。
03

平台化：项目优先、内置工具可被接管

0.51.0 – 0.65.2 · 2026-02-01 → 2026-04-06 · 53 个版本 · 515 条

二到四月，pi 从「一个能跑 agent 的终端」变成「一个能被改造的平台」：资源优先级改成项目优先、内置工具的渲染与参数可被扩展接管、扩展工具默认并行执行。破坏性变更也在 0.62.0 达到历史峰值（单版 14 条）。

  • 0.51.0 一次补齐 Android / Termux、Alpine ARM64 musl、Nix / Guix 支持，并加入 bash spawn hook（执行前改写命令）。
  • 0.55.0 资源优先级改为 项目优先（cwd/.pi 先于 ~/.pi/agent），扩展名冲突不再连坐卸载整个扩展。
  • 0.58.0 Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6 上到 1M 上下文；扩展工具调用默认并行执行，只保留 tool_call 预检用于拦截。
  • 0.62.0 内置 read/write/edit/bash/grep/find/ls 变成可扩展的 ToolDefinition，渲染器可整体替换；同时引入统一的 sourceInfo 来源溯源 —— 这一版 14 条破坏性变更，是全程最贵的一次升级。
  • 0.63.0 起 edit 支持一次改多处（multi-edit），0.64.0 让老会话里的 oldText/newText 自动折成 edits[]；0.65.0 给出 session runtime API 与 defineTool()。
0.51.0 跨平台爆发 Termux、linux-arm64-musl、Nix/Guix 同时到位。
0.55.0 项目优先 资源查找顺序倒转，项目级 .pi 覆盖用户级配置（破坏性）。
0.62.0 内置工具可扩展 七个内置工具全部 ToolDefinition 化 + sourceInfo 溯源（14 条破坏性）。
0.65.0 runtime / defineTool 会话运行时 API 与独立工具定义助手。
04

换东家与稳态：模型层统一、项目信任

0.66.0 – 0.80.10 · 2026-04-08 → 2026-07-16 · 61 个版本 · 878 条

四月到七月的主题是「收拾屋子」：仓库与 npm scope 迁到 earendil-works、`models.json` 支持注释、`ModelRuntime` 统一模型与认证、项目级资源要经过信任才加载。同期还有图像生成、Windows ARM64 二进制、`max` 思考档。

  • 0.66.0 的启动公告与 0.74.0 的「仓库链接与包名迁移」标志项目从 badlogic/pi-mono、@mariozechner/* 迁到 earendil-works/pi、@earendil-works/*；0.73.1 的 pi update --self 提前为此做了自更新兼容。
  • 0.73.1 models.json 支持注释与尾逗号（JSONC），自建 provider 终于能写说明。
  • 0.74.1 接入图像生成 API、Together AI、Windows ARM64 独立二进制。
  • 0.79.0 引入 项目信任：启动前先问是否加载项目级 settings / 扩展 / 技能；footer 同时开始显示最近一次 prompt cache 命中率。
  • 0.80.8 ModelRuntime 把模型目录、认证、刷新收成一层；/model 能后台刷新已配置 provider 的实时目录。
0.71.0 砍掉 Gemini CLI 移除 Gemini CLI 与 Antigravity 内置 provider（破坏性）。
0.73.1 JSONC models.json 允许注释与尾逗号。
0.74.0 迁到 earendil-works 仓库与包 scope 全面改名，旧链接重定向。
0.79.0 项目信任 未知项目不再自动加载本地资源；footer 显示 cache 命中率。
0.80.8 ModelRuntime 模型目录 / 认证 / 刷新统一到一层 SDK。
05

全屏 TUI 与上下文工程

0.81.0 – 0.87.1 · 2026-07-21 → 2026-09-22 · 16 个版本 · 536 条

七月末到九月，界面与上下文两头同时动刀：全屏 TUI 上线（自带 12 条破坏性变更）、Markdown 里能画 Mermaid 与 LaTeX、`AGENTS.override.md` 可按目录覆盖上下文；prompt cache 从「看不见」变成可预热、可按模型给预算。

  • 0.81.0 支持连本地 llama.cpp router，搜索并下载 Hugging Face 模型；扩展可注册完整 provider。
  • 0.84.0 全屏 TUI 模式上线（运行时可切换）、Mermaid / LaTeX 渲染、AGENTS.override.md 按目录覆盖上下文；同版 12 条破坏性变更，集中在扩展渲染接口。
  • 0.84.3 为 Windows 加可选的原生 PowerShell 工具，并把自更新改成「先暂存校验、再原子切换」。
  • 0.86.0 prompt cache 可预热（长工具调用期间保活），/bug 支持带脱敏诊断上报，压缩预算可按模型配置。
  • 0.87.0 规范化会话上下文与扩展边界：用 context_with_system 改系统消息、思考块不再被当作普通文本传递。
0.81.0 本地模型 llama.cpp router 接入 + 完整 provider 扩展。
0.84.0 全屏 TUI 全屏模式 + Mermaid/LaTeX + 目录级上下文覆盖（12 条破坏性）。
0.84.3 Windows PowerShell 可选原生 PowerShell 工具，Windows 下执行更自然。
0.86.0 缓存预热 prompt cache warming、/bug、按模型配压缩预算。
0.87.0 上下文边界 会话上下文规范化 + context_with_system。
06

codemode 纪元与 1.x 稳定化

0.99.0 – 1.3.0 · 2026-09-29 → 2026-10-15 · 11 个版本 · 291 条

0.99.0 是整个版本史里最大的一次结构变化：codemode（模型写 JS 调工具）、MCP、虚拟模型、分类器模型、system 主题一起来了。此后 1.0 把全屏设为默认，1.0–1.3 的补丁几乎都在做同一件事：**更省 token、更少缓存失效**。

  • 0.99.0 codemode + MCP + virtual models + classifier models + system 主题；扩展事件里多出 provider_stream_event 这类可观测钩子。
  • 0.99.1 GPT-6.1 Sol 成为 OpenAI 默认模型；1.1.0 起 --tools 支持 +name/-name 增量调工具，并通过 OSC 7501 上报运行状态。
  • 1.0.0 全屏成为默认 TUI（tuiMode: "regular" 可回退）；codemode 提示词瘦身约 40%（GPT-5.6 单请求约 5,300 → 3,300 token），错误信息改成「教模型怎么恢复」。
  • 1.2.0 给 settings.json / models.json / keybindings / themes 发布 $schema，编辑器里可校验可补全；OpenRouter 按 key 列出可用模型与价格。
  • 1.3.0 把「缓存不失效」做到细处：GPT-6 上中途改思考档不掉缓存、换模型时丢掉上一个模型的思考块而非塞成文本、resume 保留会话中临时启用的工具。
0.99.0 Codemode and MCP 模型写 JS 调工具、MCP 接入、虚拟/分类器模型、system 主题。
1.0.0 Fullscreen by default 全屏成为默认；codemode 提示词瘦身 40%。
1.1.0 --tools +name/-name 在默认工具集上做增量增删，不用整份重写。
1.2.0 $schema 配置文件发布 JSON Schema，编辑器校验与补全。
1.3.0 缓存友好 改思考档保缓存、换模型清思考块、resume 保留工具。

破坏性变更清单

Breaking Changes

原文照录，按版本倒序。只看 1.x 的话，只剩 5 条（1.2.0、1.0.3）。

跨大版本升级时真正会咬人的是这 121 条。历史上最贵的三次是 0.62.0（14 条，内置工具 ToolDefinition 化）、0.84.0（12 条，全屏 TUI 与扩展渲染接口）、 0.32.0 / 0.35.0（队列 API 拆分、hooks→extensions 合并）。只关心从 0.x 上到 1.3.0 的话，按这张表倒序读一遍即可。

版本日期变更内容
1.2.0 2026-10-12 Published generated configuration schemas for models, settings, keybindings, and themes at https://pi.dev/schemas/*.schema.json. The theme schema moved to https://pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json; themes loaded during startup now receive the same schema validation as later reloads. Update theme $schema references, define reusable colors under vars, and remove unsupported metadata (#9880, #10751 by @christianklotz)
1.2.0 2026-10-12 Changed before_agent_start to also fire for runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) while idle. BeforeAgentStartEvent is now a union on messageType: "user" events carry prompt and images, and "custom" events carry the starting message and no prompt. Messages returned by handlers are added to both kinds of run, and pending deliverAs: "nextTurn" messages are delivered with the custom-message run. Handlers that should act only on user prompts must check event.messageType === "user" (#10267, #5581, #10739 by @davidbrai)
1.2.0 2026-10-12 Changed the session to count as busy while a run starts, including during before_agent_start handlers: ctx.isIdle() is false, pi.sendMessage() queues into the starting run instead of starting a second run that failed with "Agent is already processing", pi.sendUserMessage() requires deliverAs, and an abort requested meanwhile aborts the run once it starts (#10739 by @davidbrai)
1.2.0 2026-10-12 Changed pi mcp list --json to report resources: true for servers that offer resources instead of resources and resourceTemplates counts; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting (#10526)
1.0.3 2026-10-05 Renamed the Azure provider from azure-openai-responses to azure. Rename the provider key in auth.json (or run /login again), in models.json, and in settings.json (defaultProvider, enabledModels patterns, and modelThinkingLevels keys). Sessions that used the old provider fall back to another model when resumed, and their prompt cache is not reused. The AZURE_OPENAI_* environment variables are unchanged (#9714 by @jsanter27)
0.87.0 2026-09-21 Removed the inherited shouldStopAfterTurn agent option. Use finishTurn and return { action: "end" } instead. finishTurn runs before turn_end but applies the decision afterward, and it also receives error and aborted responses; migrate normal-response predicates by returning undefined for those hard exits. See the @earendil-works/pi-agent-core changelog for a complete before-and-after example.
0.87.0 2026-09-21 Added ContextEditEntry to the exported SessionEntry union. TypeScript consumers with exhaustive entry switches must handle context_edit; use replacement: null for omission and a content replacement otherwise.
0.87.0 2026-09-21 Made SessionManager canonical for AgentSession provider context. Assigning session.agent.state.messages no longer replaces future request history; restore with SessionManager.inMemory(cwd, { id }, entries), navigate with session.navigateTree(), or append through session.sessionManager and call session.refreshContext().
0.87.0 2026-09-21 Expanded TurnEndEvent with required boundary fields and added AgentBeforeSettleEvent to the exported ExtensionEvent union. Consumers constructing events or exhaustively switching on ExtensionEvent must handle the new shapes. ExtensionRunner.emit() no longer accepts turn_end; host integrations dispatch actionable boundaries with emitBoundary(baseEvent, buildContext).
0.87.0 2026-09-21 Deferred runs requested from agent_settled handlers until all settled handlers finish. Handlers still observe ctx.isIdle() === true, but no longer see a reentrant agent_start during the same notification dispatch.
0.86.0 2026-09-19 Changed inherited pi-ai provider stream inputs from Context to normalized TranscriptContext values. Custom providers must read system prompts and tool declarations from context.messages with getCurrentSystemPrompt() and getCurrentTools(). See Custom Streaming API.
0.86.0 2026-09-19 Restricted inherited ToolCall.arguments and ToolResultMessage.details to JSON-compatible values, changed ToolResultMessage into a conditional type, and made JsonValue arrays readonly.
0.86.0 2026-09-19 user_bash now fails closed: errors or invalid defined results abort the command without invoking later handlers or executing locally. Return undefined to continue propagation; otherwise return { operations } or { result } (#9068).
0.84.3 2026-08-24 Renamed the inherited GoogleThinkingLevel type to GoogleApiThinkingLevel and added ResolvedGoogleThinkingLevel for normalized adapter levels.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Renamed the inherited pi-ai ModelsStreamTransforms interface to ModelsRequestTransforms because its header transformation now applies to all authenticated provider requests.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Changed JSON and RPC message_update events to emit only assistantMessageEvent deltas, removing the cumulative message and assistantMessageEvent.partial fields that caused quadratic output growth. Clients that need partial messages must assemble deltas between message_start and message_end; the latter remains authoritative (#7290).
0.84.0 2026-08-06 ModelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders() now returns ProviderHeaders with string | null values and preserves null header-deletion markers. Extensions that inspect returned headers must handle null; extensions forwarding them to pi-ai streams should pass them through unchanged. This prevents placeholder OpenAI credentials from being sent through Cloudflare AI Gateway (#7030).
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Changed ModelRegistry.refresh() to accept ModelsRefreshOptions and return ModelsRefreshResult instead of discarding cancellation and provider errors.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Changed ModelRuntime.setRuntimeApiKey() to accept auth cancellation options rather than catalog refresh options. Call refresh({ providers: [providerId], signal }) separately when remote freshness is required.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Required config-form extension OAuth refreshToken(credentials, signal) callbacks to accept and honor a concrete abort signal.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Replaced dynamic provider refresh context store access with the read-only context.stored snapshot and generation-checked context.publish() transaction.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Replaced the inherited pi-agent-core harness session model with the v4 lane-based Session, SessionStorage, and SessionRepo APIs, including durable operation records, global facts, shared sequence numbers, and tree-scoped lane views.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Promoted the inherited v2 session and AgentHarness API from pi-agent-core's experimental entrypoint to its default export and removed the experimental subpaths.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Removed the inherited legacy JSONL and in-memory repository APIs. Use pi-agent-core's v4 JsonlSessionRepo or InMemorySessionRepo, both implementing the new SessionRepo contract.
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Added the inherited required pi-agent-core FileSystem.renameFile() operation for atomic JSONL publication; custom harness file-system implementations must provide same-filesystem replacement semantics (#7707 by @davidbrai).
0.84.0 2026-08-06 Replaced experimental remote-session list summaries with durable SessionMetadata; RemoteSession.sessions no longer exposes runtime phase, model, thinking, attachment, or lock state, which remains available from acquired SessionSnapshot values (#7708).
0.83.0 2026-07-29 Upgraded bundled TypeBox aliases to 1.3.7, removing deprecated APIs including Type.Base, Type.Awaited, Type.Promise, Type.AsyncIterator, Type.Iterator, Type.Options, and Value.Mutate, while fixing compiled validation of nullable array tool arguments. Extensions using removed APIs must migrate to supported TypeBox APIs. See Package Dependencies (#7243 by @petrroll).
0.80.8 2026-07-16 Replaced the SDK's CreateAgentSessionOptions.authStorage and modelRegistry options with the async modelRuntime option. AuthStorage and its storage backends are no longer exported; use ModelRuntime (or a custom pi-ai CredentialStore), or readStoredCredential() for one-off reads of auth.json.
0.80.8 2026-07-16 Removed redundant ModelRuntime.getAll(), find(), getSnapshot(), and getAuthOptions() projections. Use the pi-ai Models methods getModels(), getModel(), getProviders(), and checkAuth() directly.
0.80.8 2026-07-16 Replaced SDK request-auth assembly through ModelRegistry.getApiKeyAndHeaders() with ModelRuntime.getAuth(). Passing a provider ID returns provider-scoped auth; passing a model also resolves built-in, models.json, and extension model headers.
0.80.8 2026-07-16 Changed extension-facing ModelRegistry.refresh() from synchronous void to Promise<void> because models.json loading is asynchronous. Extensions must await it before making synchronous registry reads.
0.80.8 2026-07-16 Moved canonical dynamic catalog refresh to async ModelRuntime.refresh()/pi-ai Models.refresh(). Legacy extension OAuth modifyModels remains supported as a synchronous compatibility projection after credential initialization.
0.80.7 2026-07-14 Removed the openai-responses compat.sendSessionIdHeader flag from models.json. Session-affinity behavior is now controlled by compat.sessionAffinityFormat ("openai", "openai-nosession", or "openrouter"). Replace sendSessionIdHeader: false with sessionAffinityFormat: "openai-nosession" (#6496 by @petrroll).
0.75.0 2026-05-17 Raised the minimum supported Node.js version to 22.19.0.
0.73.0 2026-05-04 Switched the built-in xiaomi provider from Token Plan AMS to Xiaomi's API billing endpoint, and renamed its /login display from "Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan" to "Xiaomi MiMo". XIAOMI_API_KEY now refers to the API billing key from platform.xiaomimimo.com. Users on Token Plan should switch to the appropriate xiaomi-token-plan-* provider and set the corresponding env var (#4112 by @Phoen1xCode).
0.72.0 2026-05-01 Replaced compat.reasoningEffortMap in models.json and pi.registerProvider() model definitions with model-level thinkingLevelMap (#3208). Migration: move old mappings from compat.reasoningEffortMap to thinkingLevelMap. Use string values for provider-specific thinking values and null for unsupported pi levels that should be hidden and skipped by cycling. See docs/models.md#thinking-level-map and docs/custom-provider.md.
0.71.0 2026-04-30 Removed built-in Google Gemini CLI and Google Antigravity support. Existing configurations using those providers must switch to another supported provider.
0.70.0 2026-04-23 Disabled OSC 9;4 terminal progress indicators by default. Set terminal.showTerminalProgress to true in /settings to re-enable (#3588)
0.69.0 2026-04-22 Migrated first-party coding-agent code, SDK/examples/docs, and package metadata from @sinclair/typebox 0.34.x to typebox 1.x. New extensions, SDK integrations, and pi packages should depend on and import from typebox. Legacy extension loading still aliases the root @sinclair/typebox package, but @sinclair/typebox/compiler is no longer shimmed. This migration also picks up the new @mariozechner/pi-ai TypeBox-native validator path, so tool argument validation now works in eval-restricted runtimes such as Cloudflare Workers instead of being skipped (#3112)
0.69.0 2026-04-22 Session-replacement commands now invalidate captured pre-replacement session-bound extension objects after ctx.newSession(), ctx.fork(), and ctx.switchSession(). Old pi and command ctx references now throw instead of silently targeting the replaced session. Migration: if code needs to keep working in the replacement session after one of those calls, pass withSession to that same method and do the post-switch work there. In practice, move post-switch pi.sendUserMessage(), pi.sendMessage(), and command-ctx/session-manager access into withSession, and use only the ReplacedSessionContext passed to that callback for session-bound operations. Footguns: withSession runs after the old extension instance has already received session_shutdown, old cleanup may already have invalidated captured state, captured old pi / old command ctx are stale, and previously extracted raw objects such as const sm = ctx.sessionManager remain the caller's responsibility and must not be reused after the switch.
0.68.0 2026-04-20 Changed SDK and CLI tool selection from cwd-bound built-in tool instances to tool-name allowlists. createAgentSession({ tools }) now expects string[] names such as "read" and "bash" instead of Tool[], --tools now allowlists built-in, extension, and custom tools by name, and --no-tools now disables all tools by default rather than only built-ins. Migrate SDK code from tools: [readTool, bashTool] to tools: ["read", "bash"] (#2835, #3452)
0.68.0 2026-04-20 Removed prebuilt cwd-bound tool and tool-definition exports from @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent, including readTool, bashTool, editTool, writeTool, grepTool, findTool, lsTool, readOnlyTools, codingTools, and the corresponding *ToolDefinition values. Use the explicit factory exports instead, for example createReadTool(cwd), createBashTool(cwd), createCodingTools(cwd), and createReadToolDefinition(cwd) (#3452)
0.68.0 2026-04-20 Removed ambient process.cwd() / default agent-dir fallback behavior from public resource helpers. DefaultResourceLoader, loadProjectContextFiles(), and loadSkills() now require explicit cwd/agent-dir style inputs, and exported system-prompt option types now require an explicit cwd. Pass the session or project cwd explicitly instead of relying on process-global defaults (#3452)
0.65.0 2026-04-03 Removed extension post-transition events session_switch and session_fork. Use session_start with event.reason ("startup" | "reload" | "new" | "resume" | "fork"). For "new", "resume", and "fork", session_start includes previousSessionFile.
0.65.0 2026-04-03 Removed session-replacement methods from AgentSession. Use AgentSessionRuntime for newSession(), switchSession(), fork(), and importFromJsonl(). Cross-cwd session replacement rebuilds all cwd-bound runtime state and replaces the live AgentSession instance.
0.65.0 2026-04-03 Removed session_directory from extension and settings APIs.
0.65.0 2026-04-03 Unknown single-dash CLI flags (e.g. -s) now produce an error instead of being silently ignored.
0.64.0 2026-03-29 ModelRegistry no longer has a public constructor. SDK callers and tests must use ModelRegistry.create(authStorage, modelsJsonPath?) for file-backed registries or ModelRegistry.inMemory(authStorage) for built-in-only registries. Direct new ModelRegistry(...) calls no longer compile.
0.63.0 2026-03-27 ModelRegistry.getApiKey(model) has been replaced by getApiKeyAndHeaders(model) because models.json auth and header values can now resolve dynamically on every request. Extensions and SDK integrations that previously fetched only an API key must now fetch request auth per call and forward both apiKey and headers. Use getApiKeyForProvider(provider) only when you explicitly want provider-level API key lookup without model headers or authHeader handling (#1835)
0.63.0 2026-03-27 Removed deprecated direct minimax and minimax-cn model IDs, keeping only MiniMax-M2.7 and MiniMax-M2.7-highspeed. Update pinned model IDs to one of those supported direct MiniMax models, or use another provider route that still exposes the older IDs (#2596 by @liyuan97)
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Changed ToolDefinition.renderCall and renderResult semantics. Fallback rendering now happens only when a renderer is not defined for that slot. If renderCall or renderResult is defined, it must return a Component.
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Changed slash command provenance to use sourceInfo consistently. RPC get_commands, RpcSlashCommand, and SDK SlashCommandInfo no longer expose location or path. Use sourceInfo instead (#1734)
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Removed legacy source fields from Skill and PromptTemplate. Use sourceInfo.source for provenance instead (#1734)
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Removed ResourceLoader.getPathMetadata(). Resource provenance is now attached directly to loaded resources via sourceInfo (#1734)
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Removed extensionPath from RegisteredCommand and RegisteredTool. Use sourceInfo.path for provenance instead (#1734)
0.62.0 2026-03-23 RPC get_commands: replace path and location with sourceInfo.path, sourceInfo.scope, and sourceInfo.source
0.62.0 2026-03-23 SlashCommandInfo: replace command.path and command.location with command.sourceInfo
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Skill and PromptTemplate: replace .source with .sourceInfo.source
0.62.0 2026-03-23 RegisteredCommand and RegisteredTool: replace .extensionPath with .sourceInfo.path
0.62.0 2026-03-23 Custom ResourceLoader implementations: remove getPathMetadata() and read provenance from loaded resources directly
0.62.0 2026-03-23 command.path -> command.sourceInfo.path
0.62.0 2026-03-23 command.location === "user" -> command.sourceInfo.scope === "user"
0.62.0 2026-03-23 skill.source -> skill.sourceInfo.source
0.62.0 2026-03-23 tool.extensionPath -> tool.sourceInfo.path
0.61.0 2026-03-20 Interactive keybinding ids are now namespaced, and keybindings.json now uses those same canonical namespaced ids. Older config files are migrated automatically on startup. Custom editors and extension UI components still receive an injected keybindings: KeybindingsManager. They do not call getKeybindings() or setKeybindings() themselves. Declaration merging applies to that injected type (#2391)
0.61.0 2026-03-20 Extension author migration: update keyHint(), keyText(), and injected keybindings.matches(...) calls from old built-in names like "expandTools", "selectConfirm", and "interrupt" to namespaced ids like "app.tools.expand", "tui.select.confirm", and "app.interrupt". See docs/keybindings.md for the full list. pi.registerShortcut("ctrl+shift+p", ...) is unchanged because extension shortcuts still use raw key combos, not keybinding ids.
0.60.0 2026-03-18 Changed package startup behavior so installed unpinned packages are no longer checked or updated during startup. Use pi update to apply npm/git package updates, while interactive mode now checks for available package updates in the background and notifies you when updates are available (#1963)
0.59.0 2026-03-17 Changed custom tool system prompt behavior so extension and SDK tools are included in the default Available tools section only when they provide promptSnippet. Omitting promptSnippet now leaves the tool out of that section instead of falling back to description (#2285)
0.57.0 2026-03-07 RPC mode now uses strict LF-delimited JSONL framing. Clients must split records on \n only instead of using generic line readers such as Node readline, which also split on Unicode separators inside JSON payloads (#1911)
0.56.0 2026-03-04 Changed scoped model thinking semantics. Scoped entries without an explicit :<thinking> suffix now inherit the current session thinking level when selected, instead of applying a startup-captured default.
0.56.0 2026-03-04 Moved Node OAuth runtime exports off the top-level @mariozechner/pi-ai entry. OAuth login and refresh must be imported from @mariozechner/pi-ai/oauth (#1814).
0.55.0 2026-02-24 Resource precedence for extensions, skills, prompts, themes, and slash-command name collisions is now project-first (cwd/.pi) before user-global (~/.pi/agent). If you relied on global resources overriding project resources with the same names, rename or reorder your resources.
0.55.0 2026-02-24 Extension registration conflicts no longer unload the entire later extension. All extensions stay loaded, and conflicting command/tool/flag names are resolved by first registration in load order.
0.53.0 2026-02-17 SettingsManager persistence semantics changed for SDK consumers. Setters now update in-memory state immediately and queue disk writes. Code that requires durable on-disk settings must call await settingsManager.flush().
0.53.0 2026-02-17 AuthStorage constructor is no longer public. Use static factories (AuthStorage.create(...), AuthStorage.fromStorage(...), AuthStorage.inMemory(...)). This breaks code that used new AuthStorage(...) directly.
0.52.10 2026-02-12 ContextUsage.tokens and ContextUsage.percent are now number | null. After compaction, context token count is unknown until the next LLM response, so these fields return null. Extensions that read ContextUsage must handle the null case. Removed usageTokens, trailingTokens, and lastUsageIndex fields from ContextUsage (implementation details that should not have been public) (#1382 by @ferologics)
0.52.10 2026-02-12 Git source parsing is now strict without git: prefix: only protocol URLs are treated as git (https://, http://, ssh://, git://). Shorthand sources like github.com/org/repo and git@github.com:org/repo now require the git: prefix. (#1426)
0.52.7 2026-02-06 Changed models.json provider models behavior from full replacement to merge-by-id with built-in models. Built-in models are now kept by default, and custom models upsert by id.
0.52.6 2026-02-05 Removed /exit command handling. Use /quit to exit (#1303)
0.51.3 2026-02-03 RPC get_commands response and SlashCommandSource type: renamed "template" to "prompt" for consistency with the rest of the codebase
0.51.0 2026-02-01 Extension tool signature change: ToolDefinition.execute now uses (toolCallId, params, signal, onUpdate, ctx) parameter order to match AgentTool.execute. Previously it was (toolCallId, params, onUpdate, ctx, signal). This makes wrapping built-in tools trivial since the first four parameters now align. Update your extensions by swapping the signal and onUpdate parameters:
0.50.0 2026-01-26 Header values in models.json now resolve environment variables (if a header value matches an env var name, the env var value is used). This may change behavior if a literal header value accidentally matches an env var name. (#909)
0.50.0 2026-01-26 External packages (npm/git) are now configured via packages array in settings.json instead of extensions. Existing npm:/git: entries in extensions are auto-migrated. (#645)
0.50.0 2026-01-26 Resource loading now uses ResourceLoader only and settings.json uses arrays for extensions, skills, prompts, and themes (#645)
0.50.0 2026-01-26 Removed discoverAuthStorage and discoverModels from the SDK. AuthStorage and ModelRegistry now default to ~/.pi/agent paths unless you pass an agentDir (#645)
0.47.0 2026-01-16 Extensions using Editor directly must now pass TUI as the first constructor argument: new Editor(tui, theme). The tui parameter is available in extension factory functions. (#732)
0.44.0 2026-01-12 pi.getAllTools() now returns ToolInfo[] (with name and description) instead of string[]. Extensions that only need names can use .map(t => t.name). (#648 by @carsonfarmer)
0.43.0 2026-01-11 Extension editor (ctx.ui.editor()) now uses Enter to submit and Shift+Enter for newlines, matching the main editor. Previously used Ctrl+Enter to submit. Extensions with hardcoded "ctrl+enter" hints need updating. (#642 by @mitsuhiko)
0.43.0 2026-01-11 Renamed /branch command to /fork (#641)
0.43.0 2026-01-11 SessionManager.list() and SessionManager.listAll() are now async, returning Promise<SessionInfo[]>. Callers must await them. (#620 by @tmustier)
0.39.0 2026-01-08 before_agent_start event now receives systemPrompt in the event object and returns systemPrompt (full replacement) instead of systemPromptAppend. Extensions that were appending must now use event.systemPrompt + extra pattern. (#575)
0.39.0 2026-01-08 discoverSkills() now returns { skills: Skill[], warnings: SkillWarning[] } instead of Skill[]. This allows callers to handle skill loading warnings. (#577 by @cv)
0.38.0 2026-01-08 ctx.ui.custom() factory signature changed from (tui, theme, done) to (tui, theme, keybindings, done) for keybinding access in custom components
0.38.0 2026-01-08 LoadedExtension type renamed to Extension
0.38.0 2026-01-08 LoadExtensionsResult.setUIContext() removed, replaced with runtime: ExtensionRuntime
0.38.0 2026-01-08 ExtensionRunner constructor now requires runtime: ExtensionRuntime as second parameter
0.38.0 2026-01-08 ExtensionRunner.initialize() signature changed from options object to positional params (actions, contextActions, commandContextActions?, uiContext?)
0.38.0 2026-01-08 ExtensionRunner.getHasUI() renamed to hasUI()
0.38.0 2026-01-08 OpenAI Codex model aliases removed (gpt-5, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5-nano, codex-mini-latest). Use canonical IDs: gpt-5.1, gpt-5.1-codex-mini, gpt-5.2, gpt-5.2-codex. (#536 by @ghoulr)
0.35.0 2026-01-05 Settings: hooks and customTools arrays replaced with single extensions array
0.35.0 2026-01-05 CLI: --hook and --tool flags replaced with --extension / -e
0.35.0 2026-01-05 Directories: hooks/, tools/ → extensions/; commands/ → prompts/
0.35.0 2026-01-05 Types: See type renames above
0.35.0 2026-01-05 SDK: See SDK migration above
0.33.0 2026-01-04 Key detection functions removed from @mariozechner/pi-tui: All isXxx() key detection functions (isEnter(), isEscape(), isCtrlC(), etc.) have been removed. Use matchesKey(data, keyId) instead (e.g., matchesKey(data, "enter"), matchesKey(data, "ctrl+c")). This affects hooks and custom tools that use ctx.ui.custom() with keyboard input handling. (#405)
0.32.0 2026-01-03 Queue API replaced with steer/followUp: The queueMessage() method has been split into two methods with different delivery semantics (#403):
0.32.0 2026-01-03 Settings renamed: queueMode setting renamed to steeringMode. Added new followUpMode setting. Old settings.json files are migrated automatically.
0.32.0 2026-01-03 AgentSession methods renamed:
0.32.0 2026-01-03 Hook API signature changed: pi.sendMessage() second parameter changed from triggerTurn?: boolean to options?: { triggerTurn?, deliverAs? }. Use deliverAs: "followUp" for follow-up delivery. Affects both hooks and internal sendHookMessage() method.
0.32.0 2026-01-03 RPC API changes:
0.32.0 2026-01-03 Settings UI: "Queue mode" setting split into "Steering mode" and "Follow-up mode"
0.30.0 2025-12-25 SessionManager API: The second parameter of create(), continueRecent(), and list() changed from agentDir to sessionDir. When provided, it specifies the session directory directly (no cwd encoding). When omitted, uses default (~/.pi/agent/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/). open() no longer takes agentDir. (#313)
0.29.0 2025-12-25 Renamed /clear to /new: The command to start a fresh session is now /new. Hook event reasons before_clear/clear are now before_new/new. Merry Christmas @mitsuhiko! (#305)
0.27.0 2025-12-22 Session hooks API redesign: Merged branch event into session event. BranchEvent, BranchEventResult types and pi.on("branch", ...) removed. Use pi.on("session", ...) with reason: "before_branch" | "branch" instead. AgentSession.branch() returns { cancelled } instead of { skipped }. AgentSession.reset() and switchSession() now return boolean (false if cancelled by hook). RPC commands reset, switch_session, and branch now include cancelled in response data. (#278)
0.24.0 2025-12-19 Custom tools now require index.ts entry point: Auto-discovered custom tools must be in a subdirectory with an index.ts file. The old pattern ~/.pi/agent/tools/mytool.ts must become ~/.pi/agent/tools/mytool/index.ts. This allows multi-file tools to import helper modules. Explicit paths via --tool or settings.json still work with any .ts file.
0.24.0 2025-12-19 Hook tool_result event restructured: The ToolResultEvent now exposes full tool result data instead of just text. (#233)
0.23.3 2025-12-17 Hooks: turn_end event's toolResults type changed from AppMessage[] to ToolResultMessage[]. If you have hooks that handle turn_end events and explicitly type the results, update your type annotations.
0.23.0 2025-12-17 Hooks: Replaced session_start and session_switch events with unified session event. Use event.reason ("start" | "switch" | "clear") to distinguish. Event now includes entries array for state reconstruction.
0.20.0 2025-12-13 Pi skills now use SKILL.md convention: Pi skills must now be named SKILL.md inside a directory, matching Codex CLI format. Previously any *.md file was treated as a skill. Migrate by renaming ~/.pi/agent/skills/foo.md to ~/.pi/agent/skills/foo/SKILL.md.
0.16.0 2025-12-09 New RPC protocol: The RPC mode (--mode rpc) has been completely redesigned with a new JSON protocol. The old protocol is no longer supported. See C1 for the new protocol documentation and C2 for a working example. Includes RpcClient TypeScript class for easy integration. (#91)
0.14.0 2025-12-08 Custom themes require new color tokens: Themes must now include thinkingXhigh and bashMode color tokens. The theme loader provides helpful error messages listing missing tokens. See built-in themes (dark.json, light.json) for reference values.

与本机相关

Local Impact

下面这些是从这份履历里挑出来、对本机这套配置（pi 1.3.0、Windows、自建 wb2api provider、四个 npm 包 + 三个本地扩展、codemode 开启）真正有影响的条目。

1.0.0 已生效

全屏 TUI 是默认了

本机 settings.json 没有设 tuiMode，所以现在跑的就是全屏模式。想换回终端原生 scrollback："tuiMode": "regular"，或临时 --tui-mode regular。

0.99.0 可考虑

主题仍钉在 dark，没吃到 system 自适应

0.99.0 起默认主题是 system（从终端自己的调色板取色，终端明暗切换时重建）。本机钉了 "theme": "dark" —— 想跟着终端走就把这行删掉或设为 "system"。

1.3.0 无影响

自建 provider 的 baseUrl 要带 /v1

1.3.0 把 kimi-coding 换成 Chat Completions，models.json 里覆盖它的 baseUrl 现在必须带 /v1。本机 wb2api 等自定义 provider 是 openai-completions 且 baseUrl 已含 /v1（如 http://127.0.0.1:7863/v1），不受这条影响；但以后接别的 OpenAI 兼容端点时记得同一条规矩。

1.2.0 可考虑

models.json 现在能挂 $schema

1.2.0 给 settings.json、models.json、keybindings、themes 发布了 JSON Schema。本机 models.json 有十来个自定义 provider / 模型条目，加一行 $schema 就能在编辑器里补全与报错。

0.79.7 / 0.60.0 注意

pi update 只管 pi 自己，包不会顺带升级

0.60.0 起启动不再自动更新未锁定的 npm / git 包；0.79.7 起 pi update 默认只更新 pi 自身，--all 才连 packages 一起。本机装了 pi-subagents、pi-web-access、billion-context、pi-open-tui 四个包，需要定期 pi update --all。

0.62.0 → 0.87.0 注意

本地三个扩展踩在改动最密的接口上

herdr-agent-state.ts、question.ts、questionnaire.ts 用到扩展上下文与 UI 能力：0.62.0 内置工具渲染接口重写、0.80.4 生命周期钩子（agent_settled、before_provider_request）、0.87.0 上下文边界、1.2.0 triggerTurn 走 before_agent_start、1.3.0 扩展 overlay 的 done() 只关自己的浮层。升级后若扩展表现异常，先查这几处。

1.0.0 / 1.1.0 无影响

codemode 越用越便宜

codemode 自 0.99.0 起内置。1.0.0 把提示词压掉约 40% 并让报错自带恢复提示；1.1.0 起可用 --tools +codemode,-write 在默认工具集上增量增删；1.0.4 起 --tools/--exclude-tools 支持 * 通配。

0.75.5 / 0.76.0 / 0.84.3 已生效

Windows 这三条直接受益

0.75.5 文件工具在 Windows 上改用异步文件系统操作；0.76.0 修 Windows / JetBrains 终端里的编辑行为；0.84.3 加入可选的原生 PowerShell 工具（不用再靠 bash 转发）。

0.80.6 / 1.3.0 说明

默认 thinking high，上面的档位都在

0.80.6 增加 max 档、0.80.7 起 Fable 5 支持 xhigh/max；1.3.0 在 GPT-6（API key）上中途改档不再掉缓存 —— 本机 defaultThinkingLevel: "high" 属于中间档，往上还能试 xhigh/max。

全量归档

Full Archive

289 个版本、3131 条变更，按月分组。点版本号展开条目；搜索框匹配版本号、日期与条目正文，按 / 可直接聚焦。

2026-108 个版本
1.3.0 2026-10-15 新功能 5新增 2变更 2修复 23 Choose where /share uploads

新功能5

  • Choose where /share uploads: sessionShareDestination selects auto, gist, or radius. See Sessions and context and Export or share a session.
  • Cache-preserving thinking level changes on OpenAI GPT-6: changing the thinking level mid-session with an API key keeps the prompt cache.
  • Kimi Code over Chat Completions: tools added mid-conversation no longer invalidate the prompt cache. models.json base URL overrides must now include /v1. See Providers.
  • Clean model switching: thinking from a previous model is dropped instead of being shown to the new model as text.
  • Resumed sessions keep their active tools: --tools +name/-name applies on top of them. See Tools.

新增2

  • Changing the thinking level mid-session on OpenAI GPT-6 models (API key) now keeps the prompt cache (#10853)
  • Added the sessionShareDestination setting to choose automatic, GitHub gist, or Radius uploads for /share (#10870 by @vegarsti)

变更2

  • Changed the kimi-coding provider to use OpenAI Chat Completions at https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1, the protocol used by the official Kimi Code client. K3, K3-256K, and Kimi For Coding now accept tools added mid-conversation without invalidating the prompt cache. models.json overrides of the kimi-coding base URL must now include /v1 (#10720)
  • Changed model switching to drop thinking blocks from earlier assistant messages produced by a different model, instead of sending them as plain text. The new model previously saw the old model's reasoning as part of its replies and could start writing its own reasoning into the visible answer (#10995)

修复23

  • Pinned internal Pi dependencies to exact release versions to prevent fresh installs from mixing incompatible packages (#10865)
  • Fixed resumed sessions dropping tools activated during the session. Resume now restores the session's active tools, with --tools +name/-name entries applied to them, unless --tools with tool names, --no-tools, or --no-builtin-tools selects tools explicitly (#10785)
  • Fixed stopping a codemode script or reaching its deadline waiting for a non-interruptible built-in to return on Bun (#10748)
  • Fixed repeated codemode timeouts or aborts accumulating surviving workers; admission now limits live workers to two across sessions, counting cancelled workers until actual exit (#10748)
  • Fixed --model choosing a provider by catalog order when several providers offer the match; Pi now prefers the provider with credentials and otherwise reports the ambiguity. --models and enabledModels add a model for each provider that offers it and warn about the ambiguity (#10160)
  • Fixed read line-range labels for numeric-string or null arguments in the TUI, session tree, HTML exports, and examples (#9887)
  • Fixed the Nix flake build failing when a provider switched APIs: the model catalog pin is now refreshed from the newest published catalog when its model API groups differ, and releases pin the newest catalog and build with it before tagging (#10985)
  • Fixed the Nix package putting its Node.js first on PATH, which made bash tool shells use Pi's Node instead of the user's node/npm. Pi's Node is now only a fallback (#10519)
  • Fixed prompt templates dropping empty quoted arguments ("" or ''), which shifted later positional arguments and prevented positional defaults from applying (#10867)
  • Fixed the Nix package build failing in its install check because it still expected chord and esbuild, which Pi no longer depends on
  • Fixed tool-call argument parsing dropping fields when a string contains an invalid \u escape such as \usepackage (#10868)
  • Fixed Anthropic and Bedrock Claude requests failing with a 400 when an error tool result contains images; the images are now sent after the tool results of the turn, so the model still sees them (#10794)
  • Fixed OpenCode Go Gemini models failing with a 404 by moving OpenCode Zen and OpenCode Go to the opencode.ai/inference endpoints, and added Google Generative AI support to the OpenCode Go provider
  • Fixed OpenCode Go MiniMax M2.7 failing with "Model does not support this protocol" by using the Anthropic Messages API
  • Fixed automatic retry not triggering for gateway Unable to forward upstream stream errors (#10920)
  • Fixed automatic retry not triggering for The service is temporarily unavailable errors, which also made compaction fail on the first attempt (#10965)
  • Fixed OpenAI-compatible responses showing thinking after the answer when a proxy such as LiteLLM sends reasoning and content in the same stream chunk (#10926)
  • Fixed Gemini 4 Argon requests on Google Vertex failing with "Thinking budget is not supported", and its thinking level being ignored on the Gemini API (#10890)
  • Fixed Xiaomi MiMo models failing with a 400 at the minimal thinking level; they now expose only the off and high levels (#10818)
  • Fixed openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol using a 272K context window instead of the 500K window Codex now provides (#10840)
  • Fixed tool calls whose final arguments are malformed JSON silently running with only the fields parsed before the error; they now fail validation and show the model the raw arguments it sent (#10897)
  • Fixed Claude Haiku 5.5 and Claude Opus 5 not supporting the off thinking level (#10753)
  • Fixed done() of an extension's ctx.ui.custom({ overlay: true }) closing the topmost overlay instead of its own, which left the finished overlay on screen and another extension's dialog unresolved (#10648, #10999 by @masonc15)
1.2.0 2026-10-12 新功能 5破坏性变更 4新增 5变更 4修复 23移除 2 Per-key OpenRouter model lists

新功能5

  • Per-key OpenRouter model lists: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including regional endpoints set in models.json. See OpenRouter.
  • Published configuration schemas: add $schema to settings.json, models.json, keybindings, and themes for editor validation and completion. See Settings, Models, Keybindings, and Themes.
  • Clipboard copies over remote sessions: PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1 sends copied text to a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as a multiplexer attached from another machine. See Pi Process Configuration.
  • Codemode improvements: tool declarations show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, and default, and codemode rows show elapsed and total time. See Codemode.
  • before_agent_start for extension-triggered runs: runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) go through the same setup as prompts. See Events and concurrency.

破坏性变更4

  • Published generated configuration schemas for models, settings, keybindings, and themes at https://pi.dev/schemas/*.schema.json. The theme schema moved to https://pi.dev/schemas/theme.schema.json; themes loaded during startup now receive the same schema validation as later reloads. Update theme $schema references, define reusable colors under vars, and remove unsupported metadata (#9880, #10751 by @christianklotz)
  • Changed before_agent_start to also fire for runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) while idle. BeforeAgentStartEvent is now a union on messageType: "user" events carry prompt and images, and "custom" events carry the starting message and no prompt. Messages returned by handlers are added to both kinds of run, and pending deliverAs: "nextTurn" messages are delivered with the custom-message run. Handlers that should act only on user prompts must check event.messageType === "user" (#10267, #5581, #10739 by @davidbrai)
  • Changed the session to count as busy while a run starts, including during before_agent_start handlers: ctx.isIdle() is false, pi.sendMessage() queues into the starting run instead of starting a second run that failed with "Agent is already processing", pi.sendUserMessage() requires deliverAs, and an abort requested meanwhile aborts the run once it starts (#10739 by @davidbrai)
  • Changed pi mcp list --json to report resources: true for servers that offer resources instead of resources and resourceTemplates counts; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting (#10526)

新增5

  • Added reachesTools to tool definitions, so tools that reach other tools (such as codemode and tool_search) declare which tools a call may reach; the MCP extension uses it to wait for the servers a call needs and to decide whether a replacement codemode or tool_search tool can reach MCP tools
  • Added aliases to tool namespaces; codemode's describeNamespace() and the namespace option of searchTools() match them, and MCP namespaces use the server name
  • Added per-key OpenRouter model lists: with an OpenRouter key, Pi lists only the chat models that key may use, with the key's context size, max output, and prices, including guardrails and regional endpoints set as the base URL in models.json. The list is saved and used offline (#10353, #10672 by @davidbrai)
  • Added PI_CLIPBOARD_OSC52=1 to send copied text to the terminal with OSC 52 after the local clipboard write, so copies reach a remote client's clipboard when Pi cannot detect the remote session, such as multiplexer attaches from another machine or remote IDE daemons (#10826, #10835, #10114)
  • Added elapsed time while a codemode script runs and its total time once finished to the codemode tool row, like bash rows (#10708)

变更4

  • Changed the showHardwareCursor setting to use only the terminal cursor instead of also drawing Pi's reverse-video cursor
  • Changed codemode tool declarations to show input constraints such as integer, minimum/maximum, length, pattern, and default as @ tags on property comments, so scripts see them without the tool repeating them in descriptions (#10707)
  • Changed codemode declarations of MCP tools to spell out the result type (content, structuredContent, isError) instead of referring to CallToolResult<T>, which describeTool(), searchTools(), and ALL_TOOLS showed without defining it; the codemode description no longer includes the shared MCP types
  • Changed serializeConversation() (compaction, branch summaries, bug reports) to omit thinking blocks; replayed thinking is often not in the live context, so including it could make a summarization request larger than the context it summarizes and fail

修复23

  • Fixed codemode ignoring a // @options: line that is not the first line of the script, which ran the script without the requested timeout_ms; the call now fails with an error before the script runs (#10631)
  • Fixed Mistral streams being aborted mid-generation (e.g. during long thinking) after the request timeout; the timeout now applies only to waiting for response headers (#10609)
  • Fixed a symlinked AGENTS.md in a git worktree nested inside its main repo causing no project context file to load (#10681)
  • Fixed the code mode tool description claiming every failed tool call rejects; a tool that declares an output schema resolves with its value on failure too (e.g. bash with a nonzero exit)
  • Fixed runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) removing system prompt sections added in before_agent_start after their first tool call, which changed the prompt mid-run and broke the provider prompt cache twice per run (#10267, #10739 by @davidbrai)
  • Fixed codemode blocking the process for seconds to minutes after scripts with many text() calls; joining the output items was quadratic (#10678)
  • Fixed print mode (-p) exiting 0 without a warning when the final response was cut off at the model's output token limit; it now prints the partial text, writes a warning to stderr, and exits 1 (#10799)
  • Fixed pi mcp login --help and the CLI docs describing --timeout as only the wait for the browser; it limits the whole sign-in (#10636)
  • Fixed ~ not being expanded in !pattern, +path, and -path entries of the extensions, skills, prompts, and themes settings, so entries like !~/skills/pdf matched nothing (#10765)
  • Fixed MCP servers with resources registering no tools until every resource was listed; Pi no longer lists resources when connecting, so /mcp and pi mcp list show that a server offers resources instead of counting them (#10526)
  • Fixed MCP tool calls failing when the server returns structured content that is not an object (an array, null, or a primitive, as MCP 2026-07-28 allows); codemode declarations of MCP tools without an output schema now type structuredContent as unknown instead of an object (#10416)
  • Fixed reading or writing auth.json on Windows failing with EPERM when the previous lock folder was still being deleted; Pi now retries briefly before reporting the error (#10801)
  • Fixed OpenRouter router models such as openrouter/auto showing a cost of -$1,000,000 per 1M tokens; OpenRouter's negative placeholder prices are now 0 (#10672 by @davidbrai)
  • Fixed Anthropic requests failing when the provider rejects the strict tool set for grammar size, tool count, or union limits; Pi now retries once with preferred tools non-strict (#10409)
  • Fixed "The upstream provider returned an error" not being retried as a transient provider error (#10842)
  • Fixed focused fullscreen overlays blocking mouse-wheel scrolling of the transcript (#10769)
  • Fixed fragmented terminal color replies leaking hex values into the prompt and opening the external editor (related reports: #10256, #10657)
  • Fixed inline images not rendering in Herdr since 1.1.0 (#10774 by @ogulcancelik)
  • Fixed key bindings that name a shifted symbol, such as + or ctrl++, not matching under the Kitty keyboard protocol or modifyOtherKeys (#9880 by @christianklotz)
  • Fixed the compaction status indicator embedded in a custom editor using the default muted colors instead of the editor border or thinking-level color, as the working indicator does (#10809, #10810 by @Jay-Madden)
  • Fixed MCP tool calls that were cancelled or timed out while waiting for an OAuth refresh still being sent to the server once the refresh finished (#10598)
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in accepting an authorization response with an iss parameter that could not be checked because no authorization server metadata was discovered; sign-in now fails with an issuer mismatch. Reported by @AizenvoltPrime
  • Fixed codemode failing with a broken bridge error when Pi runs under node --watch on Node 24 or 26 (#10725)

移除2

  • Removed the unreleased experimental server, client, and plugin stack (src/experimental, src/cli/experimental) and its source-only ./client and ./experimental/plugin exports; none of it was part of the published package. The @earendil-works/pi-client, @earendil-works/pi-protocol, and @earendil-works/pi-server packages it used are removed and no longer released
  • Removed the dependency on @earendil-works/chord
1.1.0 2026-10-07 新功能 5新增 9变更 2修复 22 Program status reporting

新功能5

  • Program status reporting: terminals and agent dashboards that support OSC 7501 see whether Pi is working, blocked on a dialog or login, done, or failed. See Program status.
  • Claude Haiku 5.5: anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5, with adaptive thinking up to xhigh/max effort.
  • Adjust default tools with +name/-name: --tools entries like pi -t +codemode,-write change the default selection instead of replacing it. See Tools.
  • GPT-6 Luna and image classification: OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna is available as a classifier model through the Decisions API, and codemode's models.classify() accepts images for classifiers that support them. See Use classifier models.
  • Native llama.cpp decision models: Julia-1, Laya, Kev, lev, and OpenJev served by llama.cpp 0.6.0 or later run natively as classifiers through /v1/systemone. See Classification.

新增9

  • Added +name and -name entries to --tools, which change the default tool selection instead of replacing it, for example pi -t +codemode
  • Added durationMs to the tool render context and to tool_execution_end extension events: the recorded execution time of a final tool result (#10549)
  • Added outputPad to the tool render context (#10557 by @rwachtler)
  • Added OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna as a classifier model through the Decisions API, available with OPENAI_API_KEY (see Use classifier models)
  • Added images to codemode's models.classify() context, so classifiers that accept images, such as GPT-6 Luna, can judge them
  • Added program status reporting with OSC 7501: terminals and agent dashboards that support it see whether Pi is working, blocked on a dialog or login, done, or failed. PI_PROGRAM_STATUS=1|0 overrides detection (see Terminal setup) (#10607)
  • Added aborted to agent_settled session, extension, and JSON events, so integrations can tell a cancelled run from a finished one (#10607)
  • Added Claude Haiku 5.5 (anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5), with adaptive thinking up to xhigh/max effort and prompt caching on Bedrock
  • Added native llama.cpp decision models: Julia-1, Laya, Kev, lev, and OpenJev served by llama.cpp 0.6.0 or later are listed only as classifiers through /v1/systemone instead of as chat models (see Classification) (#10382)

变更2

  • Changed outputPad to also apply to ! command output, tool output, and summary blocks (#9946, #10557 by @rwachtler)
  • Changed pi mcp login --timeout to limit the whole sign-in, including requests to the authorization server, instead of only the wait for the browser (#10565)

修复22

  • Fixed bash and PowerShell results losing Took after reloading a session, and the live Took including wall-clock steps; both now show the recorded execution time (#10549)
  • Fixed managed installs keeping every old release; pi update now keeps only the new release and the one it updated from (#10392, #10511 by @davidbrai)
  • Fixed standalone binaries loading .env, .env.local, and .env.development from the launch directory into Pi's environment (#10473)
  • Fixed !! command headers losing their dim color once output arrives (#10557 by @rwachtler)
  • Fixed the codemode description not marking searchTools(), describeTool(), and describeNamespace() as async, which led models to serialize the unawaited promise as {} (#10555)
  • Fixed codemode output items running together, so models could not tell where one text() or console.log() output ended and the next began. With several text items, each now starts with a ==> text N/M <== line, and console calls follow the other output in one <console_output> block with one line per call
  • Fixed /mcp waiting for all servers to connect before opening; the manager now updates live and remains usable while enabling, reconnecting, or disabling servers (#10562)
  • Fixed images being dropped as "could not be resized" when running under node --watch on Node 24.19+ and 26.x, where Node posts its own messages on the image resize worker channel (#10527)
  • Fixed clipboard paste doing nothing in Termux, and failed copies there omitting the Termux:API install hint (#10391)
  • Fixed ! and RPC bash output keeping fragments of color codes, such as a stray m, when a code was split across output chunks (#10504)
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-ins that could not be cancelled while waiting on the authorization server and kept running after the session ended. The sign-in screen now cancels with Esc at every step, session shutdown aborts a running sign-in, and each request to the authorization server times out after 15 seconds (#10565)
  • Fixed shutdown waiting up to 15 seconds to refresh an MCP OAuth token that was about to expire, only to close the server's session (#10565)
  • Fixed the fullscreen text selection surviving session switches and other transcript rebuilds, which highlighted unrelated text in the new transcript (#9311, #10567 by @christianklotz)
  • Fixed OpenAI models on Bedrock ignoring the thinking level and always running at Bedrock's default reasoning effort (#9331, #10142 by @jsanter27)
  • Fixed model headers in models.json not overriding the originator and User-Agent headers of Codex requests (#10429 by @lucasmeijer)
  • Fixed server_busy and servers are currently busy provider errors ending the turn instead of being retried (#10543)
  • Fixed Mistral responses that end with finish_reason: "error" not being retried (#10487)
  • Reduced context-limit request failures by estimating input at 3.5 characters per token instead of 4 when calculating output limits (#10497)
  • Fixed Radius models disabled by an organization owner still being listed
  • Fixed Anthropic browser login failing with "localhost refused to connect" when port 53692 is reserved or in use, for example by Hyper-V/WSL port exclusions on Windows: login now falls back to a free loopback port (#10571)
  • Fixed session costs undercounting long prompts on models with prompt-length pricing tiers, such as Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, and GPT-5.4, through OpenCode, OpenCode Go, OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, Google, MiniMax, and other providers
  • Fixed Markdown links not being clickable in Herdr (#10573)

  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with invalid_redirect_uri on servers with OpenID Connect client registration, such as mcp.modem.dev: pi now registers as a native client (#10493)

1.0.1 2026-10-03 新功能 5新增 6变更 2修复 13移除 1 Nix flake

新功能5

  • Nix flake — nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable runs the latest release, and nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable installs it. See Install pi.
  • Project overrides for MCP servers — .pi/mcp.json and /mcp can enable, disable, or change the exposure of a user-level server for one project. See Configure servers.
  • MCP Client ID Metadata Documents — oauth.clientRegistration: "cimd" lets authorization servers allow pi by its document URL instead of dynamic registration. See Authenticate with OAuth.

  • Added a copy key (app.message.copy, default ctrl+x) to OAuth sign-in screens in /login, /mcp, and /mcp login, which copies the sign-in URL when the browser cannot be opened or the wrapped link cannot be selected.
  • Added oauth.clientRegistration: "cimd" for MCP servers, which identifies pi with its Client ID Metadata Document on pi.dev instead of dynamic client registration, so authorization servers can allow pi by URL (#10302)
  • Added project overrides for user-level MCP servers: a .pi/mcp.json entry without command or url sets only enabled, exposure, and toolExposure of the user-level server, and /mcp can enable or disable a server for the current project (#10277)

  • Added a Nix flake for macOS and Linux: nix run github:earendil-works/pi/stable runs the latest release, and nix profile add github:earendil-works/pi/stable installs it. See Install pi (#9137)

变更2

  • pi update on global npm installations now recommends migrating to the managed installation from the pi.dev installer, which pins all dependencies.

  • Fixed Sign in with ChatGPT continuing when its callback port is taken by another login, which made the browser show "OAuth state mismatch"; it now fails with a port-in-use error (#10265)

  • Removed npm-shrinkwrap.json from the published package. npm installations no longer pin transitive dependencies, and library consumers can now override them. Use the pi.dev installer for pinned installations (#5653)
1.0.0 2026-10-01 新功能 7新增 4变更 8修复 13 Fullscreen by default

新功能7

  • Fullscreen by default — The TUI now runs fullscreen. Set tuiMode to "regular" to keep the terminal's normal scrollback. See Terminal and display.
  • Leaner codemode — About 40% fewer prompt tokens, and errors that tell the model how to recover. See Codemode.
  • Image generation in codemode — Scripts call models.generateImages() with the session's credentials. See Generate images and Use image models.
  • Radius in /login — Sign in with Radius and set up its MCP server in one step. See Radius.
  • Anthropic copy code login — Sign in when the browser runs on another machine. See Authenticate interactively.
  • MCP OAuth hardening — oauth.authServerMetadataUrl, RFC 9207 iss checks, credentials per server, and step-up sign-in that keeps granted scopes. See Authenticate with OAuth.
  • Header-only quiet startup — quietStartup: "header" keeps the version and key hints and hides the rest. See Terminal and display.

新增4

  • Added an oauth.authServerMetadataUrl setting for MCP servers that advertise a wrong OAuth authorization server or none. Pi uses the configured metadata document instead of discovery (#10172).
  • Added quietStartup: "header", which keeps the startup header with version and key hints but hides the model scope line and loaded-resource listing.
  • Added models.generateImages() to codemode scripts. It runs image models such as OpenRouter's with the session's credentials and returns base64 image blocks that image() attaches to the result; usage counts toward the session cost like models.classify(). Extensions can call ctx.modelRegistry.generateImages(). See Use image models.
  • Added a copy code login method to Anthropic /login for headless setups where the browser runs on another machine (#10194 by @lucasmeijer).

变更8

  • Changed the default TUI mode to fullscreen. Set tuiMode to "regular" or pass --tui-mode regular to keep the terminal's normal scrollback.
  • /login now offers "Sign in with Radius" at the top level, as the last option, with its status. After a Radius sign-in, /login offers to configure the Radius MCP server in the global mcp.json with "auth": { "provider": "radius" } and reloads. Cancelling a login returns to the menu it was started from.
  • The provider docs page is renamed to Providers, its "Cloud Providers" section is now "Provider Specific Config", and it documents Radius first.
  • MCP OAuth credentials are now stored per server name and URL, so MCP servers with the same URL can sign in with different accounts. Credentials stored by URL alone move to the first server that uses them (#10252).
  • Codemode costs far fewer prompt tokens: with the default tools and codemode active, a GPT-5.6 request shrinks from about 5,300 to 3,300 tokens. The codemode description lists the script globals in one line each and points to the new Codemode reference for the models API, which the model reads when it needs it. Declared tools say in one line how scripts call them and what the call resolves to, instead of repeating their full declaration, and the system prompt's codemode guidance and MCP server section are shorter.
  • Codemode errors now say how to recover: reading a tool or models member that does not exist names the close matches (tools.Bash suggests tools.bash), models.classify() and models.generateImages() reject malformed arguments with the expected shape, an unknown model points to models.getAvailableOfType(), an oversized store() value explains what the store is for, and a script that generates images without showing them gets a note. Scripts that probed for a tool with typeof tools.name must use "name" in tools.
  • /login and /logout now label providers without credentials as "not configured" instead of "unconfigured".
  • OAuth browser pages now show the color Pi logo.

修复13

  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in accepting an authorization response whose iss parameter names another authorization server; the code is now rejected before it is exchanged (RFC 9207).
  • Fixed MCP OAuth sign-in failing with Invalid scope when the token response contains "scope": "", and similar failures for other empty or null optional OAuth fields (#10266).
  • Fixed the sign-in URL printed by /mcp login not being clickable when it wraps (#10186).
  • Fixed --provider without --model being silently ignored and running the default model from another provider; it now fails with an error (#10236).
  • Fixed MCP servers that ask for more scope (insufficient_scope) requesting sign-in over and over. The new sign-in requested only the missing scopes, so the new token lost access the previous one had; it now keeps the granted scopes.
  • Fixed user messages in the transcript keeping two full-width copies of every rendered line; they keep one, with identical output.
  • Fixed /login and /logout labeling every OAuth sign-in, including Radius, as a subscription; only subscription-backed providers say "subscription", other OAuth sign-ins say "account".
  • Fixed the startup header logo rendering with gaps in Apple Terminal; it now shows a colored "Pi" with the version instead.
  • Fixed deferred MCP tools that tool_search loaded being dropped on resume and /reload even when their server reconnected before the next prompt, because the session restored its tools before the MCP servers reconnected.
  • Fixed the system theme making pastel palettes such as Catppuccin Frappe much more vivid; palette colors now keep their chroma (#10255, #10293 by @dgtlntv).
  • Fixed slash command autocompletion not triggering when the input starts with whitespace (#10218 by @haoqixu).
  • Fixed color bleeding past mouse selections and search highlights in fullscreen mode when a styled token ends at the highlight boundary (#10169).
  • Fixed memory retained per rendered message in the transcript; a long assistant message keeps about a fifth of the heap it kept before.
2026-099 个版本
0.99.2 2026-09-30 新功能 4新增 5变更 3修复 14 MCP servers stay out of the way: servers with the default co

新功能4

  • MCP servers stay out of the way: servers with the default codemode exposure are no longer listed in the codemode description and no longer block the first prompt. They appear in a short system prompt section, and scripts find their tools with searchTools() and describeNamespace(). See Control tool exposure.
  • More MCP authentication options: oauth.clientName for servers that only accept known OAuth clients, and "auth": { "provider": "<provider>" } to authenticate HTTP servers with a provider's /login token. See Authenticate with OAuth.
  • Anthropic workload identity federation from the Anthropic SDK environment variables. See Use an API key from the environment.
  • /reload enables tools newly added to the defaultTools setting. See Tools.

新增5

  • Added a description field for MCP servers (pi mcp add --description), shown with the server in the system prompt and used to rank its tools in tool search, and a describeNamespace(name) codemode helper that returns a namespace's instructions and tool names. describeNamespace() and searchTools() accept a namespace as mcp__dev-radius, mcp__dev_radius, dev-radius, or dev_radius.
  • Added an oauth.clientName setting for MCP servers (pi mcp add --oauth-client-name) to change the client name sent during OAuth client registration, for servers that only accept known clients (#10226).
  • Added "auth": { "provider": "<provider>" } for HTTP MCP servers to send a provider's current /login token as the bearer token instead of using MCP OAuth. The token is read on every request, so provider refreshes apply. Only allowed in the global mcp.json and from extensions, and requires https except on loopback hosts.
  • Added Anthropic workload identity federation from the ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID, ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID, and ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE environment variables (see Providers) (#10177, #10242 by @philfreo).
  • /reload now enables tools newly added to the defaultTools setting. Tools removed from it stay enabled, tools turned off during the session stay off unless newly added, and --tools, --no-tools, and --no-builtin-tools still override the setting (#10245).

变更3

  • MCP servers with the default codemode exposure no longer appear in the codemode description; scripts find them with searchTools(). codemode-deferred is now an alias for codemode. Use direct exposure for tools the model should see without searching (#10212).
  • The codemode description no longer includes deferred tools, tool counts, or MCP server instructions, so it no longer changes when MCP servers connect or change their tools. The tool_search description no longer lists the servers whose tools it can load, for the same reason. Servers are listed instead in an mcp_servers system prompt section with a one-line summary, updated at the start of each prompt; a changed section is appended to the conversation. Scripts read server instructions with describeNamespace() (#10212).
  • The first prompt no longer waits for MCP servers without direct tools. They connect in the background and are waited for when a codemode script names them, a script searches tools, or tool_search runs (#10212).

修复14

  • Fixed new sessions intermittently ignoring the saved default model, or warning that no models are available, when it belongs to an extension-registered native provider with a stored credential (#9962, #10190 by @davidbrai).
  • Fixed the /mcp sign-in URL not being clickable when it wraps across lines, by emitting it as a terminal hyperlink with a Cmd/Ctrl+click to open line like /login (#10186).
  • Fixed codemode image() accepting malformed base64 data or unsupported image types, which persisted an invalid image block that made every later provider request fail with HTTP 400 (#10215).
  • Fixed codemode failing to start its script worker from the standalone Windows executable (#10204).
  • Fixed prompt submission slowing down with session length, because resolving the session's model selection looked up the model catalog once per assistant message (#10198).
  • Fixed model lookups slowing down for providers with a refreshed pi.dev catalog, because merging remote catalog models took quadratic time.
  • Fixed the built-in-tool-renderer.ts and minimal-mode.ts extension examples removing the built-in tools' summaries and guidelines from the system prompt (#10072, #10193 by @christianklotz).
  • Fixed context overflow detection for Z.AI CN endpoint Prompt exceeds max length errors (#10208).
  • Fixed Anthropic requests failing when a tool schema uses keywords Anthropic strict tool use rejects, such as minimum/maximum; such tools are now sent non-strict (#9953).
  • Fixed provider retries firing immediately when a Retry-After header contains an unparseable date; they now use exponential backoff (#9571).
  • Fixed extension commands registered without a string name or handler crashing pi when typing /; the extension now fails to load with an error instead (#10054).
  • Fixed collapsed codemode and MCP tool results filling the screen when the output is one long line, such as minified JSON. Like bash output, the preview is now limited to wrapped lines instead of logical lines.
  • Fixed codemode.mode: "only" listing read, bash, edit, and write in the system prompt's tool list although requests only declare codemode (#10192).
  • Fixed codemode scripts calling the wrong MCP tool when two tool names differ only in - and _, such as read-file and read_file. Like in Codex, MCP tool and namespace names now replace - with _ (mcp__my-server__x is now mcp__my_server__x), colliding tools of a server all get a hash suffix, and server names that differ only in - and _ are rejected (#10239).
0.99.1 2026-09-29 新功能 1新增 1变更 1修复 1 GPT-6.1 Sol
